item.description: 折腾了一段时间的中文输入法，终于可以公开亮相了—— Nova 星语是一款内置了本地大模型的中文整句输入法，支持 macOS 和 Windows，开源免费。 【准】6486 句真实文本测试，首选整句准确率 80.6%。在两款国内知名开源输入法各自公开的测试集上，也拿到最高分（90.2%、93.1%）。 【不联网】模型就在你自己的电脑里，打的字不会离开这台电脑。可以用「活动监视器」或「资源监视器」自己查。 【所见即上屏】看到什么，空格就上屏什么。 【好改】紫色是结合上下文改过的词，备选就列在下面，按数字就换。Tab / Shift+Tab 逐词跳，只改一个字，不用退格重打。 【打法】全拼、双拼、自然码等五种打法，支持辅助码。全拼拼错能自动纠正。 【其它】表情、日期、符号直接打。Shift 切换中英文。 【只做打字】没有广告，没有弹窗，没有捆绑。免费，PL-3.0 开源。 下载和源码： https://t.co/8Yhh6JEjS2 有问题欢迎在评论区或 GitHub Issues 反馈。 ▎ Source

item.title: About the "Security update available" notice in the Tailscale admin console Some…
item.description: About the "Security update available" notice in the Tailscale admin console Some users have noticed that the Tailscale admin console marks their Surge device with "Security update available" and recommends updating to Tailscale 1.104.7. This notice does not apply to Surge. Surge's Tailscale support is an independent implementation of the protocol that contains zero code from the official Tailscale client. A security issue fixed in a Tailscale client release is an issue in code that Surge does not ship. The version shown in the admin console, such as 1.104.1-Surge-iOS-6.0.1-4037 , is not the version of any code running in Surge. Surge reports an official-style version number only for compatibility: the Tailscale control plane decides which capabilities to hand out based on the client version, and without a recognized one it treats the device as an outdated client and withholds them. The admin console then compares that number with the latest official release, which is what triggers the notice. The latest beta version now reports 1.104.7, so the notice no longer appears after updating. It may appear again whenever Tailscale publishes a new release, and it is safe to ignore.
